metadata.meaning: One record per person per continuous time in one seat, in the order held. start/end are the first day in and the first day out, each with a basis; endedBy says only why THIS hold ended (a win or loss elsewhere is the same vgId's next hold). A seat a new map carried over keeps one hold across bienniums; a redrawn seat's hold ends 'redistricted'. Vacancies are the gaps between holds.
